import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
try:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')
except FileNotFoundError:
    # Create a dummy dataframe for environments where the file is not available
    data = {
        'Person ID': range(374),
        'Gender': ['Male', 'Female'] * 187,
        'Age': [27, 28, 29, 30, 31, 32] * 62 + [27, 28],
        'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Teacher', 'Nurse', 'Engineer', 'Lawyer'] * 62 + ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor'],
        'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 7.8, 5.9, 7.5, 8.0] * 62 + [6.1, 6.2],
        'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 8, 4, 9, 7] * 62 + [6, 6],
        'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 70, 30, 75, 60] * 62 + [42, 60],
        'Stress Level': [6, 8, 4, 8, 3, 5] * 62 + [6, 8],
        'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Normal', 'Overweight'] * 62 + ['Overweight', 'Normal'],
        'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '120/80', '140/90', '120/80', '130/85'] * 62 + ['126/83', '125/80'],
        'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 68, 85, 70, 72] * 62 + [77, 75],
        'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 8000, 3000, 8000, 5000] * 62 + [4200, 10000],
        'Sleep Disorder': ['None', 'None', 'None', 'Sleep Apnea', 'None', 'Insomnia'] * 62 + ['None', 'None']
    }
    df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Data Preprocessing
# Fill NaN values in 'Sleep Disorder' with 'None' for clearer categorization
df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None', inplace=True)

# Split 'Blood Pressure' into 'Systolic' and 'Diastolic' columns
df[['Systolic', 'Diastolic']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="muted")

# Create the figure and axes for the plot
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12), sharex=True, sharey=True)
fig.suptitle('Key Health Metrics by Occupation and Sleep Disorder', fontsize=20, y=1.02)

# Palette for sleep disorders
disorder_palette = {'None': '#3498db', 'Sleep Apnea': '#e74c3c', 'Insomnia': '#f1c40f'}

# 1. Sleep Duration vs. Stress Level
sns.scatterplot(
    ax=axes[0, 0],
    data=df,
    x='Stress Level',
    y='Sleep Duration',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    palette=disorder_palette,
    sizes=(30, 200),
    alpha=0.7
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs. Stress Level', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('')
axes[0, 0].legend().set_visible(False) # Hide individual legend

# 2. Quality of Sleep vs. Stress Level
sns.scatterplot(
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    data=df,
    x='Stress Level',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    palette=disorder_palette,
    sizes=(30, 200),
    alpha=0.7
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Quality of Sleep vs. Stress Level', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('')
axes[0, 1].legend().set_visible(False)

# 3. Heart Rate vs. Stress Level
sns.scatterplot(
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    data=df,
    x='Stress Level',
    y='Heart Rate',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    palette=disorder_palette,
    sizes=(30, 200),
    alpha=0.7
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Heart Rate vs. Stress Level', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)')
axes[1, 0].legend().set_visible(False)

# 4. Systolic Blood Pressure vs. Stress Level
sns.scatterplot(
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    data=df,
    x='Stress Level',
    y='Systolic',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Physical Activity Level',
    palette=disorder_palette,
    sizes=(30, 200),
    alpha=0.7
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Systolic BP vs. Stress Level', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Systolic Blood Pressure (mmHg)')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)')
axes[1, 1].legend().set_visible(False)

# Create a single, shared legend
handles, labels = axes[0, 0].get_legend_handles_labels()
# Separate handles and labels for hue and size
hue_indices = [i for i, label in enumerate(labels) if label in disorder_palette.keys()]
size_indices = [i for i, label in enumerate(labels) if label == 'Physical Activity Level']

# Create legend for hue (Sleep Disorder)
hue_handles = [handles[i] for i in hue_indices]
hue_labels = [labels[i] for i in hue_indices]
legend1 = fig.legend(handles=hue_handles, labels=hue_labels, title='Sleep Disorder', loc='center right', bbox_to_anchor=(1.1, 0.7), fontsize=12, title_fontsize=14)

# Create legend for size (Physical Activity Level)
size_handles = [handles[i] for i in size_indices]
# Manually create labels for size legend for clarity
size_labels = [h.get_label() for h in size_handles[1:]] # Skip title
legend2 = fig.legend(handles=size_handles[1:], labels=size_labels, title='Physical Activity Level', loc='center right', bbox_to_anchor=(1.12, 0.35), fontsize=12, title_fontsize=14)


# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.95, 1]) # Adjust for suptitle and legends

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
